newsitem.title: JAPAN: SESC to file complaint on Nomura executives - paper.
newsitem.headline: SESC to file complaint on Nomura executives - paper.

text.p: Japan's securities watchdog plans to file a complaint with prosecutors against former executives of Nomura Securities Co Ltd and a corporate racketeer within a few days, the daily Mainichi Shimbun said on Friday.

The Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) raided Nomura's offices on March 25 in a widening probe into the brokerage's role in payments to a corporate client who has been linked to a "sokaiya" racketeer.
Sokaiya typically try to extort money from firms by threatening to expose dubious business practices or to disturb shareholders' meetings.
An SESC spokesman declined to comment on the report. A spokesman for Nomura was not immediately available to comment.
